replies.author: Robin_DD_J
replies.body:
Seeing a lot of people do not like this I'm simply going to explain why we did this. Please don't go aggressive against me and try to see it from my point of view.

Killfarming takes zero skill. But I will admit getting to that situation where you can killfarm someone takes skill. Killfarming have been an issue for a long time and adding diamond swords would prevent the farming for getting extreme. A stonesword would give 0 damage, literally. A Diamond sword though would make more damage, and the players would easily be able to take back the game. 

Killfarming may be fun, because I used to killfarm aswell. But you need to understand, people who get killfarmed will at one point leave, and we do not want that. If Avicus really want to work on getting the best rotations where the gameplay is fair,  this is one of the only ways.

I personally dont agree with this, because first, it's the other teams fault for allowing themselves to be killfarmed. In one of my recent games, while I was killfarming, the other team didnt even try to kill us. All they did was try and get us banned for spawn killing.
Before this diamond sword update came, people had to use strategies to deal with killfarmers, and take initiative.
Now all they need to do is run as a group and kill them, it also affects the other gameplay of the map, because rushers now have to always get armour before going.
I personally think this is terrible.
